items.title: [ECG] ANU Discovery Day on Sunday, 8 November 2026
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please take note that the
Australian National University (ANU)
is hosting a discovery (information) day on
Sunday, 8 November 2026
. If you are interested, please attend at your own accord.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ANU Discovery Day in Singapore
Date:
Sunday, 8 November 2026
Time:
1 pm to 5 pm
Venue:
VOCO Orchard Singapore,
581 Orchard Road Singapore, 238883 Singapore
This event presents a fantastic opportunity for your students and parents to engage with ANU staff, academics and discover the highlights of studying at ANU, an esteemed institution and Canberra as study destination. Information on admission, scholarships, career and guaranteed on-campus accommodation are also available on that day.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thank you.
Best regards,
Justin
ECG Department

items.title: [Makerspace] Post Exam Workshop - Zentangle Artistic Handpnhone Stand Workshop
items.author: Tham Siang Wah
items.description:
Would you like to have a handphone stand in which the design on it is hand drawn by yourself?
Use this opportunity to destress, celebrate the end of examination for a relaxing session with us at Makerspace.
Join us for this
Zentangle Artistic Hand Phone Stand Workshop!
Get to learn some basic on zentangle from Ms Goh and bring back a handphone stand that you can use at home!
Date: 19 October, Monday
Time: 230pm - 430pm
Venue: Makerspace@HCI, High School Section, B102
Limited to 24 students only!
Please register through this link:
https://forms.gle/K7hMpSyPuxij1nNc8
See you for the Workshop!
In the workshop and in life: we test, analyze the output, and iterate. A test score is never the finished product—it’s just Version 1.0.  Life is a continuous build, constantly adapting through Version 1.1, Version 1.2, and Version 2.0 as you reflect, learn, and grow!
Brought to you by Makerspace Team together with artist & teacher Ms Goh Mui Eng
